creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Filed by Quartermaster's orchestrator (an agent), from the review of the test leak fix (a_2jV1pAiFU).

Test daemons on the Mac now stop when their test process exits, through MUSTER_DAEMON_ENDS_WITH=<pid>. Daemons that `./dev --ssh` starts inside the devenv container get no such variable, so a run killed part way can still leave them there. The Mac fix does not carry over as it is: the pid would name a process on the Mac, which the container's daemon cannot watch. Not reproduced.
title: A killed ./dev --ssh run can leave daemons in the devenv container
